candidate_observations.address: 150-152 Clapham High Street, Clapham, London, SW4 7UH
observed_facts: PLK Investment 1 Limited trading as Popeyes pays £100,000 under a fifteen-year lease from 25 November 2024.
The restaurant tenant may determine on 10 July 2034 before the nominal July 2039 expiry.
Ten separately dated one-year room ASTs produce the remaining £164,100 of the £264,100 headline.
A billboard operator has only expressed interest at £4,000 per year; that amount is not contracted current income.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £264,100 total was not represented as one corporate covenant. The ten ASTs remain separate, the restaurant income was not projected beyond the 2034 break and the billboard interest was excluded from current rent.

observed_facts: The former bank sold for £285,000, with the sale stated to be conditional and subject to seller confirmation.
The main basement, ground, first and part-second-floor accommodation is vacant.
The majority of the second floor is sold on a 125-year lease producing £100, rising to £150 in 2035 and by £50 every 25 years thereafter.
Part of the basement is itself held for 125 years from 1977 at peppercorn rent and landlord consent is required for assignment.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £100 long-lease rent was not presented as occupational bank income. The conditional sale was not treated as unconditional completion and no redevelopment value or planning permission was inferred.
